summary: Frontend-only regression + feature testing for Agency onboarding wizard Step 1 UI parity refactor. All 6 acceptance criteria pass end-to-end via Playwright against the preview URL.

issues: Known React hydration warnings from Emergent instrumentation (<span> inside <select>) — noted as noise per request, no visual/functional impact

critical_code_review_comments: AgencyOnboarding.js is 410 lines with inline JSX for 7 channel checkboxes and conditional ID inputs — could be extracted to a shared ContactChannels component and reused with IndependentOnboarding to remove duplication.
Phone dial-code logic (COUNTRY_DIAL_CODES lookup + slice/prefix merge) is duplicated between the agency and independent flow — good candidate for a usePhoneWithDialCode hook.
